# appgatesdp_service_database_identity_provider (Resource)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24, v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the object.

### Optional

- `claim_mappings` (Attributes List) The mapping of Identity Provider attributes to claims. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--claim_mappings))
- `device_limit_per_user` (Number) The device limit per user. The existing on-boarded devices will still be able to sign in even if the limit is exceeded.
- `dns_search_domains` (List of String) The DNS search domains to be assigned to Clients of the users in this Identity Provider. Deprecated as of 6.6. Use either the Automatic Client DNS feature in Site DNS resolvers or DNS Policies. Supported in API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24.
- `dns_servers` (List of String) The DNS servers to be assigned to the Clients of the users in this Identity Provider. Deprecated as of 6.6. Use either the Automatic Client DNS feature in Site DNS resolvers or DNS Policies. Supported in API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24.
- `id` (String) ID of the object.
- `ip_pool_v4` (String) The IPv4 Pool ID the users in this Identity Provider are going to use to allocate IP addresses for the tunnels.
- `ip_pool_v6` (String) The IPv6 Pool ID the users in this Identity Provider are going to use to allocate IP addresses for the tunnels.
- `min_password_length` (Number) Minimum password length requirement for local users.
- `notes` (String) Notes for the object. Used for documentation purposes.
- `tags` (List of String) Array of tags.
- `user_lockout_duration_minutes` (Number) For how long lockout will last for local users.
- `user_lockout_threshold` (Number) After how many failed authentication attempts will a local user be locked out from authenticating again.
- `user_scripts` (List of String) ID of the User Claim Scripts to run during authorization.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Create date.
- `read_only` (Boolean) Whether the entity is protected from manual updates and deletes. Supported in API versions: v24, v25.
- `updated` (String) Last update date.

<a id="nestedatt--claim_mappings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `claim_mappings`

Optional:

- `attribute_name` (String) The name of the attribute coming from the Identity Provider.
- `claim_name` (String) The name of the user claim to be used in AppGate SDP.
- `encrypt` (Boolean) Whether the claim should be encrypted or not.
- `list` (Boolean) Whether the claim is expected to be a list and have multiple values or not.
